capabilities: Create configurable inline admonition styles with background, text color, border, corner radius, and font settings
Trigger styling via prefix, suffix, contains, or regex rules on inline codeblock content
Add prefix and suffix icons to rendered inline admonitions
Hide the triggering prefix or suffix text in the rendered output
Test regex triggers with sample input in the settings
disambiguation: Not block-level admonitions or callouts; it only restyles inline code spans that match configured trigger rules.
extras: Known issues: prefix/suffix icons do not render in Live Preview, newly created admonitions may need an app reload, and the CSS generation relies on Obsidian's private app.customCss API or a snippet file written into the vault; detailed remaining work is in FOLLOWUPS.md rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Inline callouts to make text pop.
problem: Obsidian callouts only work at block level, so text inside a line cannot be visually emphasized with backgrounds, colors, or icons.

relations.evidence: Similar to Contexual Typography this plugin will give you some css classes

summary: Styles inline codeblocks as colored callout-like bubbles, triggered by prefix, suffix, substring, or regex matching rules.
